name: Mightycause Donation Forms and Embeds
author: mightycause

sections.description:
Mightycause is an all-in-one fundraising platform for nonprofit organizations. Our user-friendly, customizable fundraising software helps nonprofits seamlessly amplify their cause, engage with donors, and manage their fundraising all in one easy-to-use place.

The Mightycause WordPress plugin allows you to embed the Mightycause donation button, widget, or form directly to your WordPress website, making it easier than ever for your visitors to donate to your cause.

This free WordPress plugin allows nonprofits to:
* Add unlimited donation buttons, widgets, or forms to your site – no coding required!
* Accept secure donations right on your website, without any redirects
* Build and blend seamlessly with your WordPress theme
* Collect recurring donations to build sustainable revenue
* Easily manage and track donor activity with Mightycause’s CRM system, Supporters

Why Mightycause?

Mightycause’s fundraising platform offers countless fundraising tools and features nonprofits can utilize to take their fundraising to the next level. By bringing your Mightycause campaigns directly to your WordPress site, organizations can create a more cohesive and streamlined fundraising experience. The Mightycause WordPress donation plugin makes giving easier, which means more donors and higher donor conversion rates!

Note: This plugin interacts with the Mightycause API to retrieve and display fundraising widgets on your website. By using this plugin, your site communicates with the Mightycause service. Please refer to their Privacy Policy and Terms of Use for more information.

Documentation and External Services

This plugin integrates with the Mightycause external service to display fundraising widgets. Data is transmitted to Mightycause for widget functionality. For more information, refer to their Terms of Use.

For more information or support, visit our help center or contact our dedicated customer service team.
sections.installation:
How to configure the Mightycause plugin on your WordPress website

  1. Activate your plugin here
  2. Head to Mightycause.com to login or create an account.
  3. Go to your Mightycause organization page dashboard. On your dashboard, select “Fundraising Tools” → “Embeds”
  4. At the top right of the page, click “Install on WordPress”
  5. Click “Continue”
  6. Copy the provided Token/unique code.
  7. Head back to your WordPress dashboard
  8. On your WordPress dashboard, go to the “Settings” → “Mightycause Widgets” to finish configuring the plugin.
  9. On the widget settings page, paste your unique code into the “Mightycause Token” field and click “Save Changes”. Your WordPress Plugin is officially configured!

How to embed the Mightycause plugin on your WordPress website

  1. To insert the plugin, you will need to have Block Editor enabled. On your WordPress post or page, click on the + Block Inserter icon.
  2. Through your WordPress Block Library search for “Mightycause.” Select Mightycause Donation Form.
  3. On the right-hand side, you will see Block Settings. Under SELECT FORM, select the embed option you would like displayed.
  4. Once selected, you will see your button, widget, or form on the page!
sections.faq:
How do I get a Mightycause WordPress Token?

You can get your token from your Mightycause organization page, under Fundraising Tools > Embeds.

Can I embed multiple embeds?

Yes, you can embed multiple donation buttons, widgets, or forms using the Gutenberg blocks provided by the plugin.

Does this plugin require a Mightycause account?

Yes, you’ll need a Mightycause account to use this plugin. You can create one at Mightycause.com.

Is there a cost to use this plugin?

The plugin itself is free. Mightycause platform fees may apply depending on your Mightycause subscription.
